Gemini defines total usage as prompt, candidates, thinking, and tool-use prompt tokens, so this path undercounts `totalTokens`. ([googleapis.github.io](https://googleapis.github.io/js-genai/release_docs/classes/types.GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata.html?utm_source=openai)) > > Add `toolUsePromptTokenCount ?? 0` to the fallback expression. > > > > > >
> Proposed fix >
>
> > ```diff > totalTokens: > - usageMetadata.totalTokenCount ?? promptTokens + completionTokens, > + usageMetadata.totalTokenCount ?? > + promptTokens + > + completionTokens + > + (usageMetadata.toolUsePromptTokenCount ?? 0), > ``` >
